title: Classic Chocolate Cake
summary: Moist two-layer chocolate cake with rich buttercream frosting and make-ahead tips.
highlights: Hot coffee amplifies the cocoa flavor without making the cake taste like coffee.
Buttercream frosting comes together in under 10 minutes with pantry staples.
Make-ahead instructions cover freezing layers and refrigerating leftovers.

title: Lemon Tart with Buttery Crust
summary: Tangy custard baked in a crisp pâte sucrée crust with detailed blind-bake guidance.
highlights: Step-by-step crust instructions include chilling, blind baking, and preventing sogginess.
Custard is cooked gently on the stovetop before finishing in the oven for a silky texture.
Storage notes explain how to keep leftovers crisp for up to three days.

title: Strawberry Shortcakes
summary: Flaky sweet biscuits layered with macerated berries and vanilla whipped cream.
highlights: Detailed biscuit technique covers folding for layers and brushing with cream for shine.
Macerating fruit with sugar and lemon builds a naturally sweet sauce.
Flexible variations encourage swapping seasonal fruit or flavoring the dough.
